tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return platform identity, service metadata, and live database health status.

tools.name: check_readiness
tools.description: Calculate statutory South African DLTC triple-hurdle computerized learner's test pass probability across Rules of the Road (min 22/28 or 78.6%), Road Traffic Signs (min 23/28 or 82.1%), and Vehicle Controls (min 6/8 or 75.0%).

tools.name: search_k53
tools.description: Search the South African K53 statutory curriculum, SADC-RTSM road signs, rules of the road, vehicle controls, common learner mistakes, and DLTC testing centres.

tools.name: check_inventory
tools.description: Check live MyLearners K53 course offerings, 100% free practice simulator availability, and real-time D1 platform candidate and completed test counts.

tools.name: get_top_mistakes
tools.description: Retrieve South Africa's most failed K53 test questions across all learners, segmented by statutory section (Rules of the Road, Road Signs, Vehicle Controls) with error frequencies, candidate counts, and mastery recovery rates.

tools.name: get_platform_stats
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive executive telemetry, candidate audience composition, test volume velocity, and real-world DLTC pass rate efficacy.

tools.name: get_outcomes_summary
tools.description: Retrieve real-world official traffic department (DLTC) driving license exam outcomes (pass rate vs 44% national baseline, failure hurdle deficits, and center performance rankings).

tools.name: get_driving_school_options
tools.description: Check South African K53 Code 8 driving school package pricing (R1,900-R6,500), live local suburb pickup coverage across Pretoria, Centurion, Midrand, and nationwide cities, and required booking fields before submitting a free callback enquiry.

tools.name: build_driving_school_booking_link
tools.description: Generate a pre-filled MyLearners 3-step driving school callback URL with role, package, transmission, city, and suburb pre-selected (contains zero personal phone/email PII in the URL).

tools.name: request_driving_school_callback
tools.description: Submit a free South African Code 8 driving school callback lead on behalf of a learner or parent after the user has explicitly confirmed their details in chat. Pure lead enquiry with no online payment required.
